description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseQueue' for managing job queues using the 'bullmq' library. It includes methods for adding jobs, creating workers, retrieving jobs, and handling queue events, with environment-configurable parameters.

classes.name: BaseQueue
classes.description: An abstract class providing queue management functionalities such as adding jobs, creating workers, and handling queue events, intended to be extended for specific queue implementations.

methods.name: getWorker
methods.description: Returns the worker instance associated with the queue.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a new job to the queue with optional removal policies based on environment variables.

methods.name: createWorker
methods.description: Creates and initializes a worker with specified concurrency, sets up event listeners, and handles job processing.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs currently in the queue.

methods.name: getJobCounts
methods.description: Returns the count of jobs in various states within the queue.

methods.name: getJobByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a job by its name.

methods.name: getQueueEvents
methods.description: Returns the QueueEvents instance for the queue.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Obliterates all jobs in the queue, forcefully clearing it.
